lines.en: I cross the peach grove over fallen leaves.
I cross the peach grove without a sound.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边抬头看枝头。
lines.en: I raise my head to the branches as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在林子边上走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk once around the grove's edge.

lines.zh: 我的角碰断了一根细枝。
lines.en: My antlers snap a thin twig.
I walk by the stream; the moss is soft.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛开花的灌木。
lines.en: I go around a flowering shrub.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往前走，没有急事。
lines.en: I walk on slowly; there is nothing to rush for.

lines.zh: 我在树影和阳光之间走。
lines.en: I pass between shade and sun.
I step through fallen petals.
I come down the slope steadily.
I look back at the grove.
I walk a few steps, then look back for you.
I walk the stone path.
My shadow runs long between the trees.
I listen to the wind as I walk.
I stand under the peach branches.

lines.zh: 我的角上挂着一片花瓣。
lines.en: A petal is caught on my antler.
A bird on the branch; I hear it clearly.
The wind here is warm.
I chew a twig with my eyes half closed.
I scrape the leaves aside for young shoots.
The peach grove is quiet.
I open my nostrils to the wind.
I am waiting for herdmates.
I lower my head to graze.
My coat shines in the light.
I stand straight as a sapling.

lines.zh: 有一片花瓣落在我背上。
lines.en: A petal has landed on my back.

lines.zh: 我一直看着林子的深处。
lines.en: I keep looking into the trees.

lines.zh: 这一小块草地就够我待。
lines.en: This small patch of grass is enough for me.

lines.zh: 阳光透过桃枝，照在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the peach branches onto my back.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角，正好对着你的影子。
lines.en: My antlers line up with your shadow.
You have come from outside the grove.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，看了你一眼。
lines.en: I turn my head and glance at you.
I am judging whether you will come near.
There is no bow on your back.
I give a little room toward the tree.

lines.zh: 你的衣角一动，我耳朵就动。
lines.en: Your hem stirs, and my ears stir too.
You are standing under my tree.

lines.zh: 我不打算离开这片桃林。
lines.en: I do not mean to leave this grove.
You would have to come quite close to touch me.
I lower my head a little.
Standing like this is fine.
I step back and my hoof slips.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我角都低下去。
lines.en: The pain made me dip my antlers.
I slip deep into the peach grove.
Ears flattened, I shrink into the grove.
I wheeled and bolted.
I look back at you as I run.
I steady myself again.
I slowly come to a stop.
My chest heaves with panting.
Only behind the peach tree do I feel safe.
Are those peaches fallen from the tree?
That smell draws me toward you.
That smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我伸长了脖子，去够那个。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out to reach it.
I will not compete with you for it.
Open your palm.
I take it gently from your palm.
That is enough.
Do you have anything else?
I smell peaches.
Step back a little and I will come.
I sniff beside your hand.
I want to beg for a little more.
While I eat, I look at nothing else.
Bring more next time.
My ears have relaxed.
You touch me and I step back.
We brush past, and I only sway.
My antlers nearly caught you.

lines.zh: 这一下碰得我耳朵一抖。
lines.en: That touch made an ear twitch.
I set all four hooves.
I shake the twigs off me.
I simply walk a few steps off.
I turned about and came back.
Do not push my antlers.
I leave this patch to you.
Only in this season am I like this.
I follow it in half a circle.
Our antlers touch.
In the grove, it and I walk slowly.
Our shadows fold into one.
The grove is full of blossom.
Our shoulders brush.
This time is quiet.
It lowers its head, and so do I.
We go deeper into the grove together.
I take it with the tip of my lip.
Too hard; I spat it out.
I sniff; a peach.
I bit it open.
I set it between two roots.
Too heavy to hold.
I push it to the tree root.
I chew a little, then pause.
I will keep this for later.
I lower my head and find another.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵竖起来对着那边。
lines.en: I lift my ears toward it.
You are not from this grove.
Half a step back, then I raise my antlers.
Antlers lowered means I do not back down.

lines.zh: 林子里的同伴都不动了。
lines.en: The herd in the grove has gone still.

lines.zh: 我从脚下发出一声低鸣。
lines.en: I let out a low sound from my throat.
This grove is ours.
I am ready to go into the trees.
I broke into a run.
I can tell you are following me.
I run a stretch and look back.
I head deeper into the grove.
I run over fallen petals.
I am not fast, but I know every path.
I pass between the trunks.
You cannot follow this ground.
I am the only one left in the grove.

lines.zh: 我在桃树后面停了一下。
lines.en: I pause behind a peach tree.
I am running again.
There is a stream ahead.
I press my antlers against your chest.
I kick out with a hoof.
My antlers were not really put into it.

lines.zh: 我角尖一挑，你退开就好。
lines.en: A flick of my antler tip, and you should step back.
I butt and run for the trees.
I turn back to watch you.
That time I put weight behind it.
The butt pushed you back a step.
I stayed put and did not chase.
That one was only to shoo you off.
A deer appears in the peach grove.
I step out from behind the blossoms.
My hooves part the fallen petals.
The peach trees are in bloom here.
My antlers show from behind the peach branch.
In the scent of peaches, I settle into this grove.
I come from the far side of the grove.
I come down on the stone path.

lines.zh: 这一片林子里有同伴的味道。
lines.en: I smell herdmates in this grove.
I come slowly to a stop.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我冲进溪里。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat; I bolt into the stream.

lines.zh: 我摔在落花上，角磕了一下。
lines.en: I land on the petals and crack my antler.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我蹬着往岸上。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I kick for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll half around.
Something lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 一股力裹住我的腿，我挣不掉。
lines.en: Some force wrapped my legs and I cannot shake it.
The peach leaves are gone and I feel faint.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我四条腿都钉住了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and nailed all four legs.
There is no ground and nothing to catch.
